title: Chicken Fajitas
summary: Spiced chicken and sautéed peppers tucked into warm tortillas, Tex-Mex style.

steps.description: Cut chicken into 1cm strips, and slice peppers and onion lengthwise. Prepare raw chicken and vegetables on separate boards.
Toss chicken with 1 tbsp olive oil, cumin, paprika, chili powder and salt.
Cook chicken in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes until it reaches at least 74°C internally, then set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, peppers and onion to the skillet and cook 5–6 minutes. Return chicken and cook 1 minute more.
Warm four tortillas for 20 seconds per side in a dry pan, fill with chicken and peppers and squeeze lime over the top.
